description: This source file defines a web page class for setting up exams in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for page load, navigation buttons, course selection, question addition, and exam setup, along with database interactions to store questions and exam details.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: ASP.NET page class for configuring exams, managing questions, and navigating within the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently no active code.
